data.name: Jagathi
data.gender_notes: Jagathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who fills the universe with her presence. Derived from the root 'Jagat' meaning the universe and 'I' signifying the self. A divine feminine name revered in Hindu mythology. The name Jagathi carries the meaning “Universal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagathi usually hope their child will grow to embody universal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the cosmos and radiating divine presence.
data.etymology: Jagathi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Universal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagathi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
